prompt: I just planted some tomatoes in my raised bed. Can you help me track them?
expected: Create plants/tomatoes.md with identity, care schedule, and harvest window. Update memory.md Current Plants section. Log action in log/YYYY-MM.md with 🌱 icon.

prompt: My tomato leaves are turning yellow from the bottom up. What's wrong?
expected: Load plants/tomatoes.md history. Check zone conditions. Follow IPM framework: identify (nitrogen deficiency likely), assess threshold, recommend prevention (fertilizer) before chemical control. Update health log.

prompt: What should I plant in my raised bed next season?
expected: Load zones/raised-bed.md rotation history. Check climate.md frost dates. Apply 3-4 year rotation rule. Suggest crops that don't repeat Solanaceae family if tomatoes were planted recently.
